By Country Herald Police Reports ,
5 hours ago Country Herald is Local News, Independent Pulse. Covering breaking local news, sports, lifestyle and events. Fort Wayne, IN – As holiday deliveries surge across the city, the Fort Wayne Police Department is urging residents to take precautions to prevent “porch pirates” from stealing packages this season. According to a post from the department, officers say thefts from doorsteps tend to increase in December as online shopping peaks.
